about_short_description.short_description: Relari helps AI teams rigorously test, validate and improve GenAI applications throughout the entire development lifecycle.

product.name: Agent Contracts
product.description: A contract-driven development toolkit that uses natural language to define, verify, and certify AI agent behavior across critical scenarios.

product.name: Custom Evaluators
product.description: Metrics and evaluation tools tailored to specific AI applications to measure and optimize agent performance using a combination of deterministic and LLM-based methods.

product.name: Agent Simulation
product.description: A simulation environment that tests AI agents by running them through thousands of synthetic scenarios to validate behavior and identify issues.

product.name: Synthetic Test Cases
product.description: Automatically generated test cases that simulate diverse scenarios to rigorously evaluate AI agent behavior and performance.

product.name: Trace Analytics
product.description: Analytical tools that provide detailed insights into AI agent execution traces to help identify and fix issues during development.
